about: Deck sets for training and testing bots (npm run bot:arena -- --decks train|holdout|legal). Sample decks (packages/gui/decks/samples) that are legal in the standard format under the restriction list below; the Cross Craft deck and csd03a/csd03b (banned cards) are left out. The holdout decks never go into training data: they test cards the bots haven't seen. Each class of a holdout deck is in the training set too.
